recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future problems with package names, transformed extension definitions, or validator messaging should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or validator/tooling documentation rather than by changing core for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-22482 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core after an STU3 implementer asked how to pre-adopt R4 extensions, such as ordinalValue, without copying them under local canonicals. The resolution called for cross-version packages to include extension definitions, validator hint behavior for early-version adoption, and documentation in the R5 core specification.
initial_application: No FHIR-22482-tagged source commit was found. The R5 application appears to have been through the broader cross-version extension section: v5.0.0 source/versions.html documented the URL pattern and package matrix for extension packages, while FHIR-28479 and FHIR-31721 refined package and validator guidance for the same area.
additional_context: The current R6 core build keeps source/versions.html and source/defining-extensions.html active. Core now preserves the cross-version package mechanism at source/versions.html while detailed extension-package definitions and older-version package guidance live in the FHIR Extension Pack, which documents use with supported FHIR versions and provides hl7.fhir.uv.extensions.r4 and hl7.fhir.uv.extensions.r3 package variants. Later FHIR-44519 formalized Extension Pack guidance for adopting artifacts in prior FHIR versions.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Reintroducing the old R5 package matrix into core would duplicate material that has intentionally moved to extension/package publications; current core source plus the Extension Pack already give the intended mechanism.
